opening.argument: The video promotes the Forsage Project as a way to earn Ethereum daily, while displaying an extraordinarily large balance as an example of earnings. The phone screen shows 7,541.88753463 ETH, and the narration links the displayed wallet activity to “earning all this money.” The video then tells viewers to check the description, which directs them to “Click this link to join” and explains how to “register and make payment.” Together, these are not neutral observations: they present impressive holdings alongside a direct invitation to participate and pay into the earning scheme.
